Suddenly, they heard a faint chirping sound coming from a nearby bush.
Popo's ears perked up, and he said, 'What was that? Let's go see!
The other friends nodded in agreement and followed Popo to the bush.
As they approached the bush, the chirping grew louder. Pipi said, 'I think it's a little bird!

The friends cheered and clapped for Gigi. 'You're so brave!' Popo said.
Momo smiled and said, 'We can help too! We're a team!
The friends all nodded in agreement, feeling happy and proud of their teamwork.
As they walked back to their play area, Popo said, 'I'm glad we helped our new friend. We can help again tomorrow!
